samples.description: 1989–2005 screened Compustat firm-years with date-valid CRSP ordinary-common listings on NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ; supports three proxy-specific Table 5 Model 1 samples using cash-flow patterns, A&R portfolios, and CRSP age quintiles.

assumptions: Direct OLS with two-way firm/year clustered inference; no absorbed fixed effects because the paper reports no fixed effects.
Zero cash flows are treated as nonpositive; missing cash flows remain unclassified.

Fiscal-period USD amounts use positive known-currency provider GBP quotes; daily GBP-to-reported and GBP-to-USD legs share a nonfuture quote date within seven days, with each leg date/type retained; market equity uses conflict-free CRSP PERMCO common-class capitalization.
The exported stage rows are contrasts with the mature reference; total stage effects are reported by native lincom in the log.
FX input rows extend only through the latest non-USD FY2006 lead date (31 May 2007); FY1984-2006 accounting support and FY1989-2005 analysis years remain fixed.
The four inputs explicitly named in footnote 12 are retained despite the printed 3–9 versus arithmetic 4–12 conflict.
Trailing t through t−4 medians and fiscal-year-specific five-portfolio sorts are best-effort choices.

Fiscal-period USD amounts use positive known-currency provider GBP quotes with shared-date daily pairs and a finite nonfuture fallback; CAPX/MVE uses conflict-free CRSP PERMCO common-class capitalization.
Direct OLS with two-way firm/year clustered inference; total stage effects are reported by native lincom in the log.
FX input rows extend only through the latest non-USD FY2006 lead date (31 May 2007); FY1984-2006 accounting support and FY1989-2005 analysis years remain fixed.
Age is CRSP first-appearance calendar years through fiscal date; annual quintiles are ranked youngest to oldest.
Middle-age quintile is the omitted reference category.

Fiscal-period USD amounts use positive known-currency provider GBP quotes with shared-date daily pairs and a finite nonfuture fallback; all size screens use conflict-free CRSP PERMCO common-class capitalization.
Direct OLS with two-way firm/year clustered inference; total stage effects are reported by native lincom in the log.
FX input rows extend only through the latest non-USD FY2006 lead date (31 May 2007); FY1984-2006 accounting support and FY1989-2005 analysis years remain fixed.

limitations: Legacy item 62 IINT is unavailable; IDIT is a best-effort semantic proxy without a direct provider mnemonic crosswalk. Missing formula components are not replaced with zero.

Final NOA and OI use their exact reduced Appendix A input requirements after algebraic cancellation; original FO/CSE/NFO and CNI/NFE intermediates remain strict and missing when their named inputs are absent. SAS equality and recovery diagnostics are documented in design.md.

Cross-rate translation uses positive known-currency quotes and coherent shared-date daily pairs; the finite nonfuture fallback and conflict-checked CRSP PERMCO market-value substitution are documented best-effort choices.
Source does not specify fiscal averaging, exact A&R window alignment, annual portfolio timing/tie handling, zero cash-flow treatment, winsorization pool, or regression estimator; see design.md.
A&R footnote 12 names four scored inputs but states a 3–9 range; the four-input sum used here has an arithmetic range of 4–12.
